name: Flualprazolam
summary: Fluorinated alprazolam has nearly double the half-life compared to its parent compound alprazolam. Additionally, the drugs potency has been reported to range from 1.5-5x stronger than alprazolam.

combinations.note: Uncertain or unpredictable interaction on PsychonautWiki.

pharmacology.text: It can be described as the 2'-fluoro derivative of alprazolam or the fluoro instead of chloro analogue of triazolam, and has similar sedative and anxiolytic effects.

uses.text: It was first synthesised in 1976, but was never marketed. It has subsequently been sold as a designer drug, first being definitively identified as such in Sweden in 2018.
